biotools.summary: LooplessFluxSampler is a toolbox for exploring the loopless mass-balanced flux solution space of metabolic models, based on an Adaptive Directions Sampling on a Box (ADSB) algorithm. It aims to provide efficient and reliable results for statistical inference in metabolic modeling.
